name: assessment
description: A v12 dated assessment of a boundary, stage or contract.

aiGuidance.purpose: Frozen history from the v12 strategy roadmap: what existed and what was missing at the assessment date.
aiGuidance.extraction: Body is markdown stating what exists, what is missing, and the assessed and review-by dates; evidence lists one citation per entry.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not a current status; it is a dated snapshot.
